title: AIOps and Sustainability: Transforming Data Centers for a Greener Future
problem: Data centers generate millions of data points per second (10 million for exascale) making management difficult and outages are increasing. Equipment continues consuming power during downtime, especially for cooling systems, wasting energy and increasing operational costs.
motivation: Data center outages result in wasted energy and increased operational costs, requiring automated solutions to improve system resiliency and sustainability.
method: The system continuously processes millions of data points per second (10 million in exascale systems) using machine learning and deep learning algorithms to detect patterns that indicate approaching failures—such as abnormal temperature or power consumption. By identifying these early warning signs, it prevents outages before they occur and stops equipment from consuming power unnecessarily during failures. This approach operates fast enough to work in real-time across modern data centers.
key_novelty: An AIOps framework that uses machine learning and deep learning to predict failures and detect anomalies, tackling two critical data center challenges simultaneously—preventing outages and reducing energy waste.
contributions: Automated anomaly detection system for multi-million data point per second sensor streams
Predictive tools for outage prevention and early failure identification
Energy efficiency optimization through predictive maintenance
limitations: Specific detection accuracy rates, quantified energy savings, and comparison with existing data center management solutions are not discussed in the abstract.
primary_theme: AI-driven operations for sustainable data centers
